Simultaneously accumulate global_sum for HAVING threshold. step_3.notes: Each thread has its own double[2000001] array (~16MB) and local global_sum accumulator. After parallel pass, reduce thread-local arrays into final array by summing element-wise. 64 threads × 16MB = 1GB total — fits easily in 376GB RAM.

notes: Key optimization: the HAVING subquery is identical to the main query (same joins, filters, aggregation expression) but without GROUP BY. Both are computed in a single pass — the main aggregation populates per-partkey sums while a scalar accumulator tracks the global sum. The threshold (global_sum * 0.0001) is applied post-aggregation. Using a direct array indexed by ps_partkey avoids hash table overhead entirely.
